workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Full3D Face Free Move

authority_chain.kernel_route: TopoShape.replaceShape / BRepTools_ReShape with sew/fix normalization and shell-to-solid rebuild when required

bounded_scope: source solid receives yaw then pitch so semantic local +X selected-face normal has non-zero X/Y/Z components
single selected-face move vector combines signed normal displacement with transformed local-Y/local-Z tangent components
R001 80x50x10 mm yaw +30 degrees pitch +20 degrees uses +2 mm outward normal component plus governed 3-4-5 tangent component
R002 100x60x12 mm yaw -25 degrees pitch -15 degrees uses -2 mm inward normal component plus governed 3-4-5 tangent component
selected face and move vector each have non-zero X/Y/Z components
target plus four adjacent faces are rebuilt through BRepTools_ReShape while opposite face remains untouched
both revisions remain valid one-solid six-face B-Rep results
edited volume is validated as source volume plus signed normal displacement multiplied by selected-face area
opposite face center and area remain unchanged and moved target remains reselectable from the semantic normal
zero move, total magnitude over 20 mm, normal component over 8 mm and selector miss all fail before accepted mutation
FCStd plus R001/R002 STEP persist selector/yaw/pitch/move/normal-component/authority metadata
Blender creates two tessellated display-only derivatives and preserves source hash/full-3D normal/full-3D move/yaw/pitch/normal component/authority across .blend save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate if full-3D selector/move derivation becomes fixed world-axis logic, semantic selector becomes raw topology index, normal/tangent/volume/opposite-face/failure gates are removed, geometry becomes mesh-authoritative, or authority does not survive Blender readback.
authority_note: This receipt proves bounded full-3D-oriented combined normal+tangent translation of one planar face. It does not prove nonplanar/general face move, persistent topological naming or P0-B PASS.
